title: Objects to Think With — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Objects to Think With's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: A light face, from the light round of 2026-11: one small thing beside one sentence, not a walk up to a test. Made by the working session (a child) in Enrichment/light-round-2026-11/, where the makers and data stay; placed here by the Concierge. No challenger read it. Every section is a proposal until Loudon approves it.

pieces.title: The lit ones
pieces.caption: Every page in Projects/ by its own icon. Twenty-three are lit as objects to think with; the five framed in red say so on their own page. Three with dotted frames were born after the count and have not been judged. *What is real and what is a choice:* The lit set is the 2026-10-25 recount's twenty-two on its looser bar, plus Cycle 5 Explorer, which declares itself. The page's text still says twenty-two of fifty-one.

verdicts.file: Objects to Think With — rich — the lit ones.png
verdicts.why: The picture breaks its own rule: Cycle 5 Explorer carries `exemplifies → Objects to Think With` ("It is an object to think with in Papert's sense", `Projects/Cycle 5 Explorer.md:83`) and is drawn dimmed, while the foot says the red frames are "the four whose own page already says so". Four pages born after the 2026-10-25 recount (Cycle 5 Explorer, Rational Hearing, Synth Templates, The Gallery) were never judged and are dimmed as if judged "no"; nothing is labelled, so the reader cannot tell which 22.
